method.audio: Every engine reads the same 16 kHz mono 16-bit PCM WAV files, decoded losslessly from the public 16-bit sources.
method.measurement: One process per engine and corpus loads the model once, runs the first clip as an unmeasured warmup, then times one inference per clip with the audio already in memory. Engines run one at a time, never in parallel.
method.latency: Latency is inference time per clip (p50 and p90 over every measured clip); real-time factor is total inference time divided by total audio duration. Lower is better.
method.wer: Corpus WER = (substitutions + deletions + insertions) / reference words, after the same normaliser is applied to reference and hypothesis: Whisper's EnglishTextNormalizer for English, Whisper's BasicTextNormalizer (lower-case, punctuation removed, diacritics kept) for other languages. A failed clip scores as an empty transcript.
method.memory: Peak phys_footprint of the benchmark process (what Activity Monitor calls Memory). Apple's engines run recognition in a system process, so their footprint is not comparable and is not reported.
method.language_modes: explicit passes the corpus language (Parakeet --language hint, Whisper -l, Apple locale); auto lets the engine detect it. Apple's engines have no auto-detect. The headline table uses explicit.
